ns2:course.label: Topics in Business Intelligence
ns2:course.description: In recent years, an increasing number of companies, large and small, have begun to utilize big data and associated analytics methods to gain information and support their decision-making. This course will introduce students to the basic principles and technology foundations of data mining, focusing on business applications of machine learning. Different topics such as different algorithms and software may be covered in different semesters. Credit is not given for both BADM 557 and BADM 453.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given for both BADM 557 and BADM 453.
